name: request:new
description: Inbox. Never picked up, body never edited.

name: bug:new
description: Reported. An agent may triage it (rule 8), and nothing more.

name: bug:needs-info
description: Could not reproduce. Waiting on the reporter.

name: bug:blocked
description: Agent stopped on a blocker in its handoff. Maintainer re-adds the label it came from.

name: feature:spec
description: Spec in progress, business and technical together.

name: feature:planned
description: Split into tasks. Never picked up itself.

name: feature:blocked
description: Agent stopped on a blocker in its handoff. Maintainer re-adds the label it came from.

name: task:draft
description: Scope written; technical spec or its spec check missing.

name: task:ready
description: Spec checked. An agent may implement it once its Depends on allow.

name: task:blocked
description: Agent stopped on a blocker in its handoff. Maintainer re-adds the label it came from.

name: dependencies
description: Pull requests that update a dependency file

name: github_actions
description: Pull requests that update GitHub Actions code

name: flaky-test
description: Names a test that fails without a code change. Delivery skips its base-commit check.

name: needs-hardware
description: PR parked: a Done when line needs a real simulator or emulator run.
